title: Assessment Task 3 - In-class Quiz Guidelines
content:
[32557 Enabling Enterprise Information Systems | Assessment Task 3 - In-class Quiz Guidelines]
Assessment Task 3 consists of two in-class paper-based quizzes:
- Quiz 1: Week 6.
- Quiz 2: Week 11.

Quiz coverage:
- Quiz 1 covers topics from Weeks 1, 2, 3, 4 and 5.
- Quiz 2 covers topics from Weeks 6, 7, 8, 9 and 10.

Quiz format:
- Each quiz is worth 15 marks (15%).
- Each quiz is 20 minutes long.
- Each quiz contains 15 multiple-choice questions.
- The quiz is conducted at the start of the student's allocated tutorial.
- The quiz is closed-book and can be attempted once.
- Students should use the weekly pre-reading questions and practice quiz activities to check their understanding.
